Original Post for clarity: OK so I'm 22. In University. This is supposed to be easy. I'm OK looking I guess, never been that beautiful a gal, but I'm just finding it really hard to find someone who wants more than a quick little fuck and chuck I do keep myself in shape so I get guys hitting on me at bars but I've never had a relationship end well that started after I was drunkety drunk in a pub.

Maybe it's just that I'm chuck material. Maybe it's because I swear like a sailor. Who knows.

I've been using Tinder, OKC, and MyBae and while OKC and MyBae have been getting me matches that share my mindset on dating I'm starting to wonder if there's something I'm doing on said dates that I should be mindful of. I tend to get a tad nervous and I wonder if that's something guys won't be keen on.

Anyway! I ramble too much. Share with me your redflags and hell even stories of dates from hell would be fun.

The advice was actually pretty varied and a lot of it actually stuck with me and I feel it will for a long time to come.

Where you're looking for romance matters more than you think - It wasn't the fact that people commented on the fact I've tried bars and dating apps. But their personal impressions of someone thinking that it was an acceptable way to do so. I hadn't given it too much of a thought about where I had been dating or rather trying to date but now that I have it makes perfect sense. That day I signed up to 3 unrelated social clubs at my university that interest me. One of which I've immediately hit it off with someone and it was so much more relaxed than when I'm out with the girls at a bar or pub.

Having sex early on is still considered an unladylike/poor move despite everything we hear about personal empowerment - Everyone seemed in agreement that it was a stupid idea to hook up within a couple of dates. I never have, personally, but a lot of people on Voat agreed that it devalued their initial impression of someone if they did. So setting boundaries is important. Guys want to get laid but they don't want to get laid too quickly. It's hypocritical but I can see the thinking behind it really.

You are the sum of your friends / the sum of your friends says a lot about you - While I hadn't mentioned my friends a few people commented about how an indicator of a person's personality is through what kind of company they keep. I'm lucky I guess in that my friends are more or less equally split across gender. But if you have one gender dominate it might highlight or give the impression of some undesirable qualities. This is because it's seen normal/proper to have a decent split across the genders and people assume that you're flawed if you don't.

Most success stories come from shared interests - I'm very happy that I've signed up for more clubs and there's social events on meetup.com I'm going to over the weekend so fingers crossed there! It seems that I was being a bit naive in assuming that people who attend these want to focus more on the hobby/interest at hand. Instead I've looked at them in a new light as an opportunity to meet someone special.

All in all I just want to say a big thank you to everyone who gave me advice as it really helped. I've been quite down on myself and it's been really liberating just to say "Fuck it" and try things out. So yes, thank you all :) Voat is honestly a very supportive community and I think it's about time I stopped lurking so much and started contributing around here!
I tried out Voat's dating advice from a couple of days ago. It's been surprising for me to say the least.
Fuck it: the words spoken by people who are about to do something awesome.

The dont have sex within a couple of dates is dumb. Don't listen to this one. It IS hypocritical. My longest two relationships started off as one night stands. If the person looks at you negatively for liking sex and being spontaneous and in the moment, then that's the red flag.

The friends part is important. You can find someone that seems great but they have 0 friends, or maybe 1, and they don't hang out much. This is very bad. This means you are their go-to all the time and it will smother you so badly. They will want to spend 100% of their spare time with you, and when you need a little room to breathe they will accuse you of not liking them. Gotta find someone with a healthy amount of quality friends.
